simple.summary: סִיוָן (Çîyvân) means Sivan , the third Hebrew month First listed occurrence: Esth 8 9.

definitions.full: H5510. Sivan סִיוָן proper name of 3rd month, Siwan = May-June (loan-word from Assyrian -Babylonian Simânu , compare Schr COT Neh 1:1 Muss-Arn JRL xi (1892), 82 ff. ; Palmyrene סיון Lzb 328 Cook 84 ); — ס הוּאתֹֿדֶשׁ הַשְּׁלִישֹׁי ׳בַּחֹדֶשׁ Est 8:9 .
